section_or_rule_title: Application of the Act (The ₹3,500 Threshold and Exemptions)
legal_status_notes: CRITICAL KARNATAKA RENT THRESHOLD: Section 2(3)(e) excludes premises with monthly rent > ₹3,500 in Bengaluru and other Part A cities (> ₹2,000 elsewhere), and commercial premises > 14 sq meters. Such tenancies fall under the Transfer of Property Act, 1882.

exact_text:
(1) Notwithstanding anything contained in section 107 of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882, no person shall, after the commencement of this Act, let or take on rent any premises except by an agreement in writing.
(2) Every agreement referred to in sub-section (1) shall be registered with the Controller within such period and in such manner and on payment of such fee as may be prescribed.
(3) Where an agreement has been entered into before the commencement of this Act, the landlord and tenant shall, within six months from such commencement, enter into an agreement in writing and get it registered with the Controller.
legal_status_notes: Mandates written agreement and registration with Rent Controller.
Statutory grounds of eviction for premises under rent control. 2 months notice for rent arrears.
